questions.prompt: A company offers to fund an analyst’s vacation if the analyst gives its shares a favorable rating. What is the most appropriate response?
choices: Decline the offer and maintain independent judgment.
Accept the offer if the analyst was already bullish.
Accept the offer if the rating is disclosed.
questions.detail: 礼物直接以有利评级为条件，会损害独立客观。应拒绝，并按正常流程形成评级。

questions.prompt: An analyst combines public sales data with a nonmaterial comment from a supplier. The combined evidence supports a trade. Which statement is most accurate?
choices: The conclusion is prohibited whenever one input is nonpublic.
The conclusion may be used if no material nonpublic information was used.
The conclusion can be used only after the supplier publishes the comment.
questions.detail: 拼图理论允许把公开信息与非重大非公开信息综合分析。若任何一项已构成重大非公开信息，就不能据此交易。

questions.prompt: Before a public announcement, a CFO privately tells an analyst that expected revenue will be 35% below published guidance. What should the analyst do first?
choices: Trade a small amount to reduce existing risk.
Refrain from trading or causing others to trade on the information.
Send the fact to a single favored client.
questions.detail: 明显偏离公开指引且尚未披露的信息可能同时具备重大性与非公开性。禁止个人交易及促使他人交易。

questions.prompt: A new issue is oversubscribed among suitable client accounts that requested shares. Which allocation policy best supports fair dealing?
choices: Fill the highest-fee client's order first.
Apply a pre-established fair allocation rule, such as pro rata by eligible order size.
Fill whichever client sent the most recent email first.
questions.detail: 应事先制定合理、可重复的分配规则，对合格客户公平执行。公平不要求每个客户得到一样数量。

questions.prompt: A client’s documented mandate prioritizes capital preservation and near-term liquidity. Which change should the manager take before adding illiquid venture capital exposure?
choices: Determine whether the allocation fits the client's investment objectives and constraints.
Ignore the liquidity requirement for a small position.
Add the investment if the fund has the highest past return.
questions.detail: 适当性应结合书面约束和整个组合评估。潜在回报或较小仓位本身不能替代适当性判断。

questions.prompt: A manager shows only the firm’s top-performing strategy in a way that implies it represents all client portfolios. The clearest concern is that the presentation is:
choices: acceptable if the performance period is short.
misleading about the scope of performance.
necessarily accurate because the strategy's returns are real.
questions.detail: 即使单一策略数字真实，也不能通过选择性展示暗示其代表全部客户。应准确说明样本范围。

questions.prompt: An analyst writes a report about a company in which the analyst has a material ownership interest. What is the best action concerning the ownership?
choices: Disclose the interest prominently in plain language.
Disclose it only if management rejects the recommendation.
Mention it only after publication if a reader asks.
questions.detail: 持股可能影响或被认为影响客观性。应及时、醒目、用清楚语言披露重大利益。

questions.prompt: An adviser will receive a referral fee if a prospective client hires a recommended provider. When should the adviser disclose the arrangement?
choices: Only when the fee exceeds the provider’s own fee.
Before the prospective client enters the related agreement.
Only after the first referral fee is paid.
questions.detail: 应提前向适用各方披露推荐利益的性质及估计金额或价值，使客户能判断偏倚。

questions.prompt: A portfolio manager wants to buy a stock for a personal account immediately before placing client orders for the same stock. Which order takes priority?
choices: The personal order if the manager uses a different broker.
The personal order if it is smaller.
questions.detail: 客户交易应优先于同一证券中从业者的个人受益交易。换券商或减小金额不改变冲突。

questions.prompt: A new analyst receives a model with an undocumented revenue assumption driving most of the valuation. What should the analyst do before publishing?
choices: Delete the assumption from the chart and publish the target price.
Investigate and document the rationale for the material assumption.
Publish because the spreadsheet runs without errors.
questions.detail: 投资建议应建立在充分研究和合理依据上。检查表能运行只能验证机械操作。

questions.prompt: Which record best supports the reasoning for a published research recommendation?
choices: Only a screenshot of the recommendation headline.
Only a list of clients who downloaded the report.
The dated valuation inputs, model version, and rationale used in the report.
questions.detail: 应保留支撑结论的记录，例如模型、输入、重要假设和研究理由，便于复核形成过程。

questions.prompt: Which sentence most clearly separates fact from opinion in a research report?
choices: Next year’s 4% growth is a historical fact.
Revenue grew 6% last year. We estimate 4% growth next year.
Revenue growth is currently 4% next year.
questions.detail: 已公布的历史结果与预测性质不同。标清估计或判断可避免误导。

questions.prompt: A portfolio gains 20% in year one and loses 10% in year two. What is its annualized geometric return, closest to?
A cash flow of 1,210 is due in two years. With annual compounding at 10%, its present value is closest to:
An asset’s expected future cash flows stay fixed and positive. All else equal, a higher required return results in:
questions.detail: 折现率越高，给定的正现金流折回今天的价值越低。

questions.prompt: A model flags 80% of future defaults and 10% of future nondefaults. If 5% of issuers default, approximately what proportion of flagged issuers default?
questions.detail: 在 100 个等比例样本中约有 4 个真阳性与 9.5 个假阳性。后验概率为 4 ÷ 13.5 ≈ 29.6%。

questions.prompt: Under the same sampling assumptions and with unchanged sample variability, quadrupling the sample size changes a mean’s standard error to:
questions.detail: 均值标准误为 s ÷ √n。样本量变成 4 倍，平方根变成 2 倍。

questions.prompt: Which procedure most directly describes Monte Carlo simulation of a portfolio value?
choices: Calculate the portfolio value under only the average input scenario.
Rescale one historical observation without drawing any other scenarios.
Draw many input scenarios from a specified joint distribution and revalue the portfolio.
questions.detail: 蒙特卡洛模拟在设定分布和依赖结构下反复抽样，再用各情景估算结果分布。

questions.prompt: For independent observations, which procedure produces a standard nonparametric bootstrap sample of size n from n historical observations?
choices: Draw n observations from an assumed normal distribution with fitted parameters.
Randomly sample n observations with replacement.
Take the n observations in reverse order.
questions.detail: 非参数自助法从经验样本有放回抽样。同一观测可重复出现，部分观测可能未抽中。

questions.prompt: A 50/50 portfolio holds two assets whose annual standard deviations are both 20%. Their return correlation is zero. What is the portfolio standard deviation, closest to?
An investor wants the lowest portfolio variance while achieving at least a 7% expected return. In the optimization, the 7% requirement is best described as:
questions.detail: 目标函数是最小化方差。最低预期收益率是限制可行权重的约束。

questions.prompt: A model predicts returns from the perspective of month-end. A feature uses financial statements released two weeks later. The key problem is:
questions.detail: 模拟当时的投资决策只能使用当时可知的信息。把未来公布的数据当作已知会夸大效果。

questions.prompt: An analyst wants to evaluate a model that forecasts next-month returns using past market data. Which split is most appropriate?
choices: Train on later dates and test on earlier dates.
Train on earlier dates and test on later dates.
Randomly mix dates after using future values to scale the full dataset.
questions.detail: 时间序列应保持先后顺序。预处理与训练只用训练期可知数据，测试模拟向前预测。

questions.prompt: A language model reports a covenant term in a public filing. Before using it in a valuation, an analyst should first:
choices: check the term and its context against the original filing.
treat the answer as verified because it is stated confidently.
use a longer generated answer as independent confirmation.
questions.detail: 生成文本可能出错。直接回到原始披露核对原文、范围和适用日期。

questions.prompt: At a point on its demand curve, a product's own-price elasticity is −1.8. A small 1% increase in price implies a quantity demanded change closest to:
questions.detail: 局部变动用弹性乘价格百分比变动。负号表示价格与需求量反向。

questions.prompt: A manufacturer paid a nonrefundable amount for an old feasibility study. In deciding whether to start production today, that payment is:
questions.detail: 历史支出已发生且不能收回，不随今天的产量决定变化。

questions.prompt: A factory’s noise imposes uncompensated costs on nearby residents. Without regulation, private marginal cost will generally be:
questions.detail: 社会边际成本等于私人边际成本加外部边际成本。厂商未承担居民损失时，私人边际成本较低。

questions.prompt: Country A sacrifices 2 units of wheat to produce one extra machine. Country B sacrifices 4 units. Which has comparative advantage in machines?
questions.detail: 比较优势取决于机会成本。A 为每台机器放弃的小麦更少。

questions.prompt: A central bank increases its policy rate with the aim of reducing demand-driven inflation. This is an example of:
questions.detail: 提高政策利率属于紧缩性货币政策，可通过融资成本和需求渠道传导。

questions.prompt: A government raises spending while holding tax rates and other policy settings fixed. In the usual short-run framework, the immediate demand effect is most likely:
questions.detail: 政府购买直接计入总需求。后续乘数效应和融资影响另行考虑。

questions.prompt: An economy’s nominal GDP is 525 and its GDP deflator is 105, on a base of 100. What is real GDP?
EUR/USD is quoted as 1.20 US dollars per euro and USD/JPY as 150 yen per dollar. What is the implied number of yen per euro?
questions.detail: 按单位相乘，1.20 美元/欧元 × 150 日元/美元 = 180 日元/欧元。

questions.prompt: The spot exchange rate is 1.2500 home currency units per foreign unit. The matching forward is 1.2550. Relative to spot, the foreign currency trades at a:
questions.detail: 本币/外币报价下，远期买入一单位外币需要更多本币，故外币有远期升水。

questions.prompt: In a broad economic contraction, which development is most consistent with weakening aggregate demand?
questions.detail: 需求预期转弱时，企业通常推迟非必要投资并降低产能利用。个别企业表现可不同。

questions.prompt: A price ceiling is imposed below the competitive equilibrium price. With downward-sloping demand and upward-sloping supply, it creates:
choices: no difference between quantity supplied and demanded.
questions.detail: 约束性上限使价格低于均衡，需求量大于供给量。

questions.prompt: Which market structure most directly requires firms to consider a small number of rivals’ likely responses to pricing decisions?
choices: A pure monopoly with no potential entrants.
questions.detail: 寡头市场由少数有影响力的竞争者构成，企业决策存在战略相互依赖。

questions.prompt: Profit is 80, depreciation expense is 12, and trade receivables increase by 15. With no other adjustments, operating cash flow by the indirect method is:
questions.detail: 加回非现金折旧 12，减去尚未收现的应收增加 15，得到 77。

questions.prompt: Cash is 30, short-term marketable securities 20, receivables 50, inventory 70, and current liabilities 80. What is the quick ratio?
A firm purchases the same inventory units at steadily rising costs. Relative to weighted-average cost, FIFO generally produces:
choices: the same ending inventory value in all cases.
higher current cost of goods sold.
lower current cost of goods sold.
questions.detail: 先进先出使较早购入的低成本单位先计入销售成本。其他条件相同时期末存货价值较高。

questions.prompt: Equipment costs 120, has expected residual value of 20, and a useful life of five years. Annual straight-line depreciation is:
A deductible temporary difference is expected to reduce taxable income in a future period. Subject to recognition criteria, it gives rise to a:
questions.detail: 未来可抵扣额预期减少未来应交所得税，满足条件时确认为递延所得税资产。

questions.prompt: Profit margin is 8%, asset turnover is 1.5, and the equity multiplier is 2.0. What is return on equity using the three-step DuPont formula?
questions.detail: ROE = 利润率 × 资产周转率 × 权益乘数 = 8% × 1.5 × 2.0 = 24%。

questions.prompt: A software firm receives payment upfront for a one-year subscription with even delivery over time. At receipt, it most likely records:
choices: an expense and a contract asset.
only revenue and an increase in receivables.
questions.detail: 尚未履行服务义务。收款形成现金增加和合同负债，之后随履约确认收入。

questions.prompt: Which potential common shares are included when calculating diluted EPS?
choices: All potential shares regardless of effect.
Those that have a dilutive effect under the applicable method.
Only instruments that were actually exercised during the period.
questions.detail: 稀释每股收益只纳入具有稀释作用的潜在普通股。反稀释工具排除。

questions.prompt: In a common-size income statement, most line items are typically expressed as a percentage of:
questions.detail: 利润表纵向比较通常以收入为基准。资产负债表通常以总资产为基准。

questions.prompt: EBIT is 90 and interest expense is 15. What is EBIT interest coverage?
questions.detail: 按题设，利息保障倍数 = EBIT ÷ 利息费用 = 90 ÷ 15 = 6。

questions.prompt: Under a typical on-balance-sheet lessee model, a lease at commencement generally results in recognition of:
choices: a right-of-use asset and a lease liability.
only an operating expense for the full future rent.
questions.detail: 在一般表内租赁模式下，承租人取得使用权并承担付款义务，分别确认相关资产和负债。

questions.prompt: Reported profit rises, but operating cash flow falls for several periods as receivables grow faster than revenue. The most appropriate next step is to:
choices: assume the profit growth is entirely cash-backed.
examine collection, revenue quality, and working-capital drivers.
questions.detail: 利润与现金流背离提供进一步调查线索。应核查账龄、收款和收入确认，避免直接下定论。

questions.prompt: A project costs 100 today and pays 60 at the end of each of the next two years. At a 10% discount rate, its NPV is closest to:
Market-value weights are 60% equity and 40% debt. Equity costs 12%, pre-tax debt costs 5%, and the tax rate is 25%. What is WACC?
Days inventory outstanding is 55, days sales outstanding 31, and days payable outstanding 46. What is the cash conversion cycle?
questions.detail: 现金转换周期 = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数 = 55 + 31 − 46 = 40 天。

questions.prompt: Two independent projects have positive NPV, but the firm lacks the capital to undertake both. Its selection problem is best described as:
questions.detail: 当资本预算约束使企业不能接受所有正净现值项目时，需要做资本配给。

questions.prompt: Two mutually exclusive projects have different scales. At the appropriate discount rate, the project with the lower IRR has the higher positive NPV. Which criterion best serves value maximization?
choices: Select the higher-IRR project regardless of NPV.
Reject both because their rankings differ.
questions.detail: 互斥项目比较股东价值增量，以适当折现率下的净现值排序。

questions.prompt: Two firms have the same sales and EBIT. The first has a higher contribution margin and higher fixed operating costs. Which has greater operating leverage at that sales level?
questions.detail: 在给定销售点，经营杠杆系数 = 边际贡献 ÷ EBIT。分母相同，边际贡献更高者杠杆更大。

questions.prompt: A chief executive uses company money on mainly personal perks. This most directly illustrates a conflict between:
choices: a firm and the tax authority.
questions.detail: 所有权与控制权分离后，管理者可能以公司资源谋取个人利益。

questions.prompt: Which board feature is most directly meant to improve independent oversight of management?
choices: A majority of directors without material ties to management.
Combining every committee chair with the CEO role.
Management deciding its own compensation without oversight.
questions.detail: 独立董事能降低管理层对监督过程的影响。独立性强弱还要结合具体关系判断。

questions.prompt: An issuer repurchases common shares for cash and keeps them as treasury shares. All else equal, the number of outstanding shares:
questions.detail: 库存股不计入流通在外股数。已发行股数是否减少取决于是否注销。

questions.prompt: A supplier offers terms of 2/10, net 30. What does the 2 refer to?
choices: A 2% charge if payment occurs before 10 days.
A 2% discount for payment within 10 days.
questions.detail: 2/10 表示 10 天内支付可减价 2%，否则通常第 30 天付全额。

questions.prompt: A business earns NOPAT of 22 on invested capital of 200. If WACC is 8%, its economic profit is:
An analyst changes only the project’s unit selling price and recomputes NPV across several values. This is best described as:
questions.detail: 单因素敏感性分析逐次改变一个输入，其他输入保持不变。

questions.prompt: The risk-free rate is 3%, beta is 1.1, and the equity risk premium is 5%. What cost of equity does CAPM imply?
questions.detail: 股权资本成本 = 无风险利率 + β × 市场风险溢价 = 3% + 1.1 × 5% = 8.5%。

questions.prompt: A stock is expected to pay a dividend of 2.10 next year. With a 9% required return and perpetual growth of 3%, its value is:
questions.detail: 固定增长股利模型的分子为下一期股利。2.10 ÷ (9% − 3%) = 35。

questions.prompt: A stable company expects to pay out 40% of next-year earnings. Its required return is 10% and growth is 4%. The justified forward P/E under constant growth is closest to:
questions.detail: 远期合理 P/E = 股利支付率 ÷ (必要收益率 − 增长率) = 0.40 ÷ 0.06 ≈ 6.67。

questions.prompt: Equity market value is 280, debt market value is 90, and excess cash is 25. There is no preferred stock or minority interest. What is enterprise value?
questions.detail: 企业价值 = 普通股市值 + 有息债务市值 − 超额现金 = 345。

questions.prompt: A stock is valued using discounted positive future cash flows. Holding projections fixed, the cost of equity rises. What is the likely valuation impact?
questions.detail: 题设只改变折现率。正现金流在更高折现率下的现值较低。

questions.prompt: A model uses a 2% risk-free rate, market beta of 0.8 with a 5% market premium, and value beta of 0.5 with a 2% value premium. What required return does it imply?
New entrants can enter a business at low cost and buyers face low switching costs. Which is the most reasonable base-case implication for incumbent margins?
choices: Incumbents necessarily keep higher margins forever.
Competitive pressure can limit persistent excess margins.
Buyer bargaining power is automatically zero.
questions.detail: 进入壁垒与转换成本低，竞争者更容易抢走客户，超额利润较难长期维持。

questions.prompt: A trader submits a buy limit order at 24.00. If it executes, the fill price must be:
questions.detail: 买入限价规定可接受的最高成交价。订单可能按限价或更低价格成交，也可能不成交。

questions.prompt: Company A is worth 40 and company B is worth 60 in a two-stock market-cap-weighted index. A returns 10% and B returns −5%. The index return before rebalancing is:
Under semi-strong-form market efficiency, security prices reflect:
choices: both public and all private information.
questions.detail: 弱式涵盖历史价格等市场信息。半强式扩展至全部公开信息，强式还包括非公开信息。

questions.prompt: A stable firm retains 60% of earnings and earns a 15% return on equity. Under the standard retention-growth relation, sustainable growth is:
questions.detail: 在假设条件下可持续增长 = 留存率 × ROE = 60% × 15% = 9%。

questions.prompt: An analyst expects a retailer’s return on invested capital to rise after logistics upgrades. Which evidence best tests that thesis?
choices: The total count of conference presentations by management.
Measured fulfillment cost and inventory productivity before and after rollout.
The color of the retailer’s logo after rollout.
questions.detail: 投资论点应关联可检验的业务驱动因素。物流成本和库存效率能帮助验证资本回报改善机制。

questions.prompt: A two-year bond pays 4 annually per 100 face amount. With a 5% annual yield, its price is closest to:
A bond has modified duration of 5.2. Ignoring convexity, what is its approximate price change for a 25 bp yield increase?
For an option-free bond with positive convexity, adding a convexity adjustment to a duration-only price-change estimate will generally:
choices: change only estimates for yield increases.
add a negative adjustment for either direction.
add a positive price adjustment for either direction of yield change.
questions.detail: 凸性项约为 0.5 × 凸性 × 收益率变动平方，因此在正凸性下为正。

questions.prompt: Which bond has the lowest coupon reinvestment risk when held to maturity?
questions.detail: 零息债存续期没有票息需要再投资。持有到期仍可能面临信用风险等其他风险。

questions.prompt: To value a bond with known cash flows from a spot curve, each cash flow should be discounted using:
choices: the spot rate for its own maturity.
the shortest spot rate for all cash flows.
questions.detail: 即期利率对应特定期限的零息折现率。每笔现金流使用自身期限的利率。

questions.prompt: The one-year spot rate is 4% and the two-year spot rate is 5%, both annually compounded. The implied one-year rate beginning in one year is closest to:
A corporate bond yields 6.2% and a maturity-matched government benchmark yields 4.6%. The simple yield spread is:
Exposure is 2 million, one-period default probability is 4%, and loss given default is 50%. What is one-period expected loss ignoring discounting?
When market yields fall substantially, the issuer of a callable bond is more likely to:
choices: extend the bond to a higher coupon automatically.
call the bond and refinance at a lower rate.
lose the right to call the bond.
questions.detail: 收益率下降时，发行人可能行使赎回权，以更低成本融资。具体以条款为准。

questions.prompt: The 2-year yield falls from 4.0% to 3.5%, while the 10-year yield stays at 4.4%. What happens to the 10-year minus 2-year spread?
questions.detail: 期限利差由 0.4 个百分点变为 0.9 个百分点，扩大 50 个基点。

questions.prompt: On the same issuer, which claim generally has higher contractual priority than subordinated debt?
questions.detail: 一般情况下高级债务先于次级债务受偿，股东权益位于债权之后。担保和具体合同还会影响顺位。

questions.prompt: An analyst wants to estimate the price sensitivity to a change specifically at the five-year point of the benchmark curve. Which measure is best suited?
questions.detail: 关键利率久期衡量价格对指定期限关键利率变化的敏感度，适用于非平行曲线风险分析。

questions.prompt: A long forward agrees to buy one unit at 75. The underlying is worth 83 at maturity. The long’s payoff is:
questions.detail: 远期多头到期损益 = 标的到期价值 − 约定交割价 = 83 − 75 = 8。

questions.prompt: A long put has a strike of 50 and the underlying finishes at 44. Ignoring the premium, its expiry payoff is:
questions.detail: 看跌多头到期收益 = max(执行价 − 标的价格, 0) = 6。

questions.prompt: A trader pays 3 for a long call with strike 25. At expiry the stock is 30. Ignoring financing, what is the trader’s profit?
questions.detail: 到期支付为 30 − 25 = 5。减去初始权利金 3，利润为 2。

questions.prompt: A grain producer plans to sell output in three months and is concerned about a fall in the price. A direct futures hedge is to:
choices: buy the grain today in the cash market.
questions.detail: 生产者未来要卖出现货，天然暴露于价格下跌。期货空头可对冲这一方向。

questions.prompt: Which feature most directly distinguishes exchange-traded futures from typical bilateral forwards?
choices: The absence of any agreed price.
Daily mark-to-market settlement through margin accounts.
An obligation only for the contract buyer.
questions.detail: 期货通过保证金账户逐日结算。通常远期交易在到期时按约定结算。

questions.prompt: A European call is 9, its matching put is 4, and the present value of the strike is 45. With no dividends and no arbitrage, spot price is:
A borrower pays a floating rate on its loan and wants to convert its exposure to fixed. Which plain interest rate swap position best serves this goal?
questions.detail: 互换收到的浮息抵消贷款浮息，剩余互换固定支付及未匹配利差。

questions.prompt: An airline hedges jet fuel exposure with crude oil futures. The two prices later move by different amounts. The residual risk is best described as:
questions.detail: 使用相关但不同的标的会留下两者相对价格变动风险，即交叉套保中的基差风险。

questions.prompt: Other pricing inputs are fixed. Higher volatility generally changes the value of a plain European put how?
questions.detail: 看跌多头的到期收益具有凸性，下行可获益且收益下限为零，其他因素固定时波动上升通常增值。

questions.prompt: A non-dividend asset is worth 100. The one-year risk-free rate is 4% with annual compounding. What is its no-arbitrage one-year forward price absent other carrying costs?
questions.detail: 现金持有复制为买现货并融资，远期交割价 = 100 × 1.04 = 104。

questions.prompt: A bilateral uncollateralized forward has positive value to a dealer. If the counterparty defaults now, the dealer is exposed to:
choices: the replacement cost of the favorable position.
the full notional in every case.
only the option premium paid on the forward.
questions.detail: 违约使有利合约可能无法兑现，风险按替代该头寸的价值衡量，具体损失还与回收率有关。

questions.prompt: An investor owns a stock and wants a temporary downside floor while retaining upside. Which strategy achieves this before considering premium cost?
choices: Sell a put on the held stock.
Short a forward for the full stock position.
Buy a put on the held stock.
questions.detail: 股价跌破执行价时看跌收益抵消进一步损失。股票上涨时仍有参与收益的机会。

questions.prompt: A private equity fund typically pays fees and calls capital well before major investments are realized. Which term best describes initially weak net performance followed by potential improvement?
questions.detail: 基金前期费用和投资支出较多，退出回款较晚，累计净回报可能先降后升。

questions.prompt: In a private equity fund, carried interest is typically tied to:
choices: investor profits under the fund distribution rules.
the benchmark short-term interest rate alone.
questions.detail: 业绩分成依基金分配规则、门槛及瀑布条款计算，和固定管理费是不同项目。

questions.prompt: An income property has stabilized annual net operating income of 600,000. At a 6% capitalization rate, its indicative value is:

With an upward-sloping commodity futures curve that stays unchanged, a fully collateralized long investor rolls from a cheaper near contract into a higher-priced next contract. The roll component tends to be:
questions.detail: 在持续升水结构下，长头寸所持远月合约随到期接近较低的现货水平，展期成分通常为负。

questions.prompt: A hedge fund prohibits ordinary investor withdrawals for the first year. This provision is a:
questions.detail: 锁定期要求投资者在一定期限内持有投资，普通赎回受限。

questions.prompt: A hedge fund uses a high-water mark. After a loss, a key purpose of this clause is to:
choices: prevent charging incentive fees again merely for recovering past losses.
guarantee the investor recovers all losses.
force the manager to cut management fees to zero.
questions.detail: 高水位线通常要求净值超过过去计费峰值后才能再次就相应增值收取业绩费。

questions.prompt: A regulated transmission network has a long asset life and tariffs set under a regulatory framework. Which risk remains especially relevant?
choices: No material risk once construction is complete.
A guarantee that operating costs will never change.
Changes in regulation and allowed returns.
questions.detail: 监管规则、准许回报和费率调整会影响现金流。投入运营后也仍有经营风险。

questions.prompt: Which asset strategy most directly funds early-stage companies with high potential growth and limited operating histories?
questions.detail: 风险投资通常为早期或成长早期企业提供权益资本，回报高度分散且退出不确定。

questions.prompt: In a leveraged buyout, increasing acquisition debt while holding the initial enterprise price fixed generally:
choices: eliminates the possibility of equity loss.
increases the sensitivity of equity outcomes to operating performance.
questions.detail: 更多债务意味着更高的固定偿债要求及更薄的权益缓冲，股权回报对经营表现更敏感。

questions.prompt: A hedge fund database deletes closed funds along with their historical returns. What bias can this create in reported averages?
choices: Only measurement noise with no selection effect.
A guaranteed downward bias from transaction fees.
questions.detail: 失败或表现较差的基金更可能关闭并被删去，剩余样本回报可能偏高。

questions.prompt: Private real estate values are updated by infrequent appraisals. Relative to timely market prices, reported returns may show:
choices: smoother returns and lower measured volatility.
questions.detail: 滞后的估值对市场冲击反映较慢，会平滑报告收益，可能低估实际波动。

questions.prompt: Which structure most directly offers listed shares representing interests in a portfolio of income-producing real estate?
questions.detail: 上市权益型 REIT 间接持有并经营收益性物业。投资者通过交易所买卖其份额。

questions.prompt: A portfolio places 30% in asset A with expected return 5% and 70% in asset B with expected return 9%. Expected portfolio return is:
A portfolio is mean–variance efficient if no feasible alternative offers:
choices: a higher risk for the same expected return.
higher expected return for the same risk or lower risk for the same expected return.
a lower expected return for the same risk.
questions.detail: 有效组合没有可行的同风险更高收益或同收益更低风险的支配者。

questions.prompt: Which type of risk broadly remains in a well-diversified equity portfolio?
choices: Only the risk of one firm changing CEO.
questions.detail: 分散化能减少特质风险。共同市场因素导致的系统性风险仍然存在。

questions.prompt: An investment returns 11%, the risk-free rate is 3%, and the return standard deviation is 16%. What is the Sharpe ratio?
questions.detail: 夏普比率 = (投资收益 − 无风险利率) ÷ 总波动率 = 8% ÷ 16% = 0.50。

questions.prompt: Which measure is the standard deviation of a portfolio’s return minus its benchmark’s return?
questions.detail: 跟踪误差用相对基准收益的波动率衡量主动风险。

questions.prompt: A client needs a large cash withdrawal in one year for a home purchase. In an investment policy statement, this should primarily be captured under:
questions.detail: 短期确定支出需要可变现资产以满足支付，属于流动性约束。

questions.prompt: A strategic allocation targets 60% equities and 40% bonds. Equities appreciate, moving the mix to 70/30. What trade restores the target weights, ignoring costs?
choices: Buy only equities with the same portfolio value.
questions.detail: 当前股票超配，债券低配。减持股票并增持债券可以恢复目标配置。

questions.prompt: Two investors have an equal willingness to take risk. One has a shorter horizon and contractual spending needs. Which is more likely to have lower ability to take risk?
choices: The investor with no near-term spending needs.
The investor with the shorter horizon and spending needs.
questions.detail: 风险承担意愿是主观偏好，承担能力受期限、支出和财务资源等客观约束。

questions.prompt: A daily 95% VaR is 3 million under a stated model. What is the correct interpretation of the model’s estimate?
choices: About 5% of daily losses are expected to exceed 3 million.
The average loss on the worst 5% of days is exactly 3 million.
questions.detail: VaR 是损失分布的分位数。给定最坏尾部的平均损失是预期短缺。

questions.prompt: Which statistic estimates the average loss in the worst portion of outcomes specified by a confidence level?
choices: Beta relative to a broad index.
questions.detail: 预期短缺衡量越过 VaR 分位点后尾部损失的平均程度。

questions.prompt: An investor treats a tax refund as “free money” and takes greater investment risk with it than with existing savings. The behavior best illustrates:
questions.detail: 心理账户是按资金来源或用途分账判断，即使货币在经济上具有可替代性。

questions.prompt: Two asset classes have low normal-period correlations but become highly positively correlated during market stress. What happens to their diversification benefit in stress, all else equal?
choices: It cannot change when individual volatilities are fixed.
questions.detail: 组合方差含协方差项。相关性升高使共同波动增大，分散化收益减弱。

terms.title: fiduciary duty
terms.detail: 受托人在授权范围内为受益人利益谨慎行事，并处理与自身利益的冲突。

terms.title: independence and objectivity
terms.detail: 投资判断应基于证据，避免受礼物、关系或施压扭曲。

terms.title: material nonpublic information
terms.detail: 尚未向市场公开且可能影响理性投资者决策或证券价格的信息。

terms.title: mosaic theory
terms.detail: 通过结合公开信息与非重大非公开信息得出投资判断。

terms.title: fair dealing
terms.detail: 向客户分发建议、执行交易与分配机会时，应按公平且一致的规则处理。

terms.title: suitability
terms.detail: 根据客户目标、约束和组合整体风险判断投资是否合适。

terms.title: performance presentation
terms.detail: 准确说明业绩计算口径、范围、期限及重要限制，使读者不被误导。

terms.title: conflict of interest
terms.detail: 个人或机构的其他利益可能妨碍其对客户或雇主应尽的义务。

terms.title: referral fee
terms.detail: 为介绍客户或服务提供者而收付的费用、补偿或其他利益。

terms.title: priority of transactions
terms.detail: 客户和雇主的相关交易应优先于从业者有受益权的个人交易。

terms.title: reasonable basis
terms.detail: 投资结论应基于足以支持判断的研究、证据和检查。

terms.title: record retention
terms.detail: 保留支持研究、建议、交易和客户沟通的必要材料。

terms.title: confidentiality
terms.detail: 妥善保护客户和潜在客户的非公开信息，按适用规则处理例外。

terms.title: misrepresentation
terms.detail: 以错误陈述、遗漏关键信息或不当归属误导他人。

terms.title: market manipulation
terms.detail: 以误导性信息或交易行为人为扭曲市场价格、成交量或判断。

terms.title: duty of loyalty
terms.detail: 在承接职责时优先考虑应受保护一方的利益。

terms.title: duty of care
terms.detail: 以胜任且审慎的方式执行职责，核查并监测重要事项。

terms.title: prudent person
terms.detail: 用处于相似情境的谨慎、胜任人士会采取的行为衡量决策。

terms.title: client mandate
terms.detail: 明确投资范围、目标、约束及双方职责的书面或约定授权。

terms.title: disclosure
terms.detail: 及时清晰地告知可能影响决策的关系、风险、假设或费用。

terms.title: pro rata allocation
terms.detail: 根据合格申请数量或份额等预定基数同比例分配有限资源。

terms.title: front running
terms.detail: 利用已知即将执行的客户或机构订单先为自己交易获益。

terms.title: soft dollars
terms.detail: 以经纪交易佣金而非单独现金支付换取研究或其他经纪服务的安排。

terms.title: additional compensation
terms.detail: 正常雇佣报酬以外、可能与职责产生利益冲突的报酬或利益。

terms.title: supervisory responsibility
terms.detail: 负有管理职责者应采取合理措施建立并执行监督和合规流程。

terms.title: due diligence
terms.detail: 在作出建议、估值或选择合作方之前，核对重要事实和假设。

terms.title: selective disclosure
terms.detail: 仅向部分对象提供可能影响决策的重要信息的做法。

terms.title: composite
terms.detail: 按共同投资策略或目标归集用于业绩展示的一组投资组合。

terms.title: plagiarism
terms.detail: 将他人的文字、观点或分析呈现为自己的成果而缺少适当归属。

terms.title: whistleblowing
terms.detail: 向适当的内部或外部渠道报告涉嫌违规或不当行为。

terms.title: geometric mean return
terms.detail: 各期增长因子连乘后取相应次方根，再减 1，表示每期等效复合收益。

terms.title: arithmetic mean return
terms.detail: 各期简单收益率求和后除以期数，用于描述观测期的平均水平。

terms.title: required return
terms.detail: 投资者为承担给定时间和风险而要求的最低预期收益率。

terms.title: present value
terms.detail: 未来现金流按适用利率折算到当前时点的价值。

terms.title: future value
terms.detail: 当前金额或现金流按复利推算到未来指定时点的价值。

terms.title: discount factor
terms.detail: 将未来一个货币单位折回估值时点的乘数。

terms.title: compounding
terms.detail: 利息或收益被计入本金，并在后续期间继续产生收益。

terms.title: holding period return
terms.detail: 持有期间的价值变化和分配收入之和相对于期初价值的比率。

terms.title: money-weighted return
terms.detail: 考虑外部现金流规模和时点、通常由内部收益率求得的投资回报。

terms.title: time-weighted return
terms.detail: 分外部资金流时间点计算子期回报并连乘，削弱申赎规模与时点影响。

terms.title: variance
terms.detail: 随机变量相对均值的平方偏差的期望，或其样本估计。

terms.title: standard deviation
terms.detail: 方差的平方根，与原变量使用相同单位。

terms.title: covariance
terms.detail: 反映两个变量相对均值如何共同变动的带单位量。

terms.title: correlation
terms.detail: 标准化协方差，描述线性共同变动的方向和强度。

terms.title: skewness
terms.detail: 描述分布不对称程度，右尾相对较长通常体现为正偏。

terms.title: kurtosis
terms.detail: 标准化的四阶中心矩，对远离均值的大幅观测较敏感。

terms.title: conditional probability
terms.detail: 在另一事件已发生的条件下，指定事件发生的概率。

terms.title: Bayes' rule
terms.detail: 利用先验概率和条件似然，把新证据转化为后验概率。

terms.title: sampling distribution
terms.detail: 按同一抽样过程重复取样时，统计量可能取值的分布。

terms.title: standard error
terms.detail: 统计量抽样分布的标准差，表示估计在重复抽样中的波动。

terms.title: confidence interval
terms.detail: 由样本构造的区间，其生成程序在重复抽样中具有规定覆盖率。

terms.title: null hypothesis
terms.detail: 统计检验中假定成立、由数据提供反对证据的命题。

terms.title: p-value
terms.detail: 假定原假设成立时，得到与观察值至少同样极端的检验统计量的概率。

terms.title: Monte Carlo simulation
terms.detail: 从设定的概率模型中反复抽样，以近似结果分布。

terms.title: bootstrap
terms.detail: 通常从观测样本有放回地重复抽样，以估计统计量的抽样性质。

terms.title: portfolio variance
terms.detail: 收益风险的平方度量，由权重、个别资产方差和资产间协方差共同决定。

terms.title: portfolio optimization
terms.detail: 在投资约束下求解使收益、风险或效用目标最适宜的资产权重。

terms.title: look-ahead bias
terms.detail: 在历史检验中使用策略当时实际上无法取得的信息。

terms.title: out-of-sample test
terms.detail: 用未参与拟合或参数选择的数据检验模型的泛化能力。

terms.title: large language model
terms.detail: 在大量语言数据上训练的模型，可理解与生成文本，产出需核对。

terms.title: price elasticity of demand
terms.detail: 需求量百分比变动相对于商品自身价格百分比变动的比率。

terms.title: income elasticity
terms.detail: 需求量百分比变动相对于消费者收入百分比变动的比率。

terms.title: cross-price elasticity
terms.detail: 一种商品的需求量百分比变动相对于另一商品价格变动的比率。

terms.title: marginal cost
terms.detail: 产出增加一单位带来的总成本增量。

terms.title: opportunity cost
terms.detail: 选择某项行动时放弃的最佳可行替代方案的价值。

terms.title: sunk cost
terms.detail: 已发生且不能收回的成本，不应影响当前的增量方案比较。

terms.title: externality
terms.detail: 某方行动对第三方造成、未被交易价格充分反映的成本或利益。

terms.title: comparative advantage
terms.detail: 以较低机会成本生产某种商品或服务的能力。

terms.title: tariff
terms.detail: 对进口或出口商品征收的税，通常按价值或数量计征。

terms.title: exchange rate
terms.detail: 用一种货币表示的另一种货币单位的价格。

terms.title: spot exchange rate
terms.detail: 约定在通常近期结算日兑换两种货币的价格。

terms.title: forward exchange rate
terms.detail: 今天确定、在指定未来日期兑换货币的价格。

terms.title: forward premium
terms.detail: 同一报价口径下某货币的远期价格高于即期价格。

terms.title: forward discount
terms.detail: 同一报价口径下某货币的远期价格低于即期价格。

terms.title: cross rate
terms.detail: 通过各自对同一第三种货币的报价推导的双边汇率。

terms.title: purchasing power parity
terms.detail: 从可比商品购买力解释两种货币相对价值的理论。

terms.title: monetary policy
terms.detail: 中央银行通过政策利率、流动性或其他工具影响金融条件和宏观目标。

terms.title: fiscal policy
terms.detail: 政府通过支出、税收和转移支付调整总需求或资源配置。

terms.title: policy rate
terms.detail: 中央银行设定或引导、用来传导货币政策的短期利率。

terms.title: inflation
terms.detail: 一定期间总体价格水平持续上升。

terms.title: deflation
terms.detail: 一定期间总体价格水平持续下降。

terms.title: nominal GDP
terms.detail: 以当期市场价格计量的本期境内最终产品与服务价值。

terms.title: real GDP
terms.detail: 按可比价格衡量的境内最终产品与服务产出，剔除价格变化的影响。

terms.title: GDP deflator
terms.detail: 名义 GDP 与对应实际 GDP 之比，通常以基期 100 表示。

terms.title: aggregate demand
terms.detail: 在给定总体价格水平下，经济各部门对最终产品和服务的总支出。

terms.title: business cycle
terms.detail: 经济活动经历扩张、峰值、收缩和谷底等阶段的波动。

terms.title: price ceiling
terms.detail: 对合法交易价格设置的最高值，低于均衡时可能造成短缺。

terms.title: perfect competition
terms.detail: 众多价格接受者提供同质产品，单个卖方难以改变市场价格。

terms.title: oligopoly
terms.detail: 少数企业占有较大市场份额，彼此决策存在战略依赖。

terms.title: monopoly
terms.detail: 单一卖方在缺少近似替代品的市场中拥有显著定价权。

terms.title: balance sheet
terms.detail: 反映特定日期的资产、负债和所有者权益。

terms.title: income statement
terms.detail: 反映一个期间的收入、费用以及相应利润。

terms.title: cash flow statement
terms.detail: 按经营、投资和筹资活动列示期间现金和现金等价物的变动。

terms.title: operating cash flow
terms.detail: 日常经营活动现金流入与流出的净额。

terms.title: accrual accounting
terms.detail: 按照权利义务和履约时点确认收入或费用，现金结算可在不同期间。

terms.title: accounts receivable
terms.detail: 通常起因于赊销、客户尚未支付给企业的对价。

terms.title: inventory
terms.detail: 持有以供销售、正处生产中或将在生产中耗用的资产。

terms.title: cost of goods sold
terms.detail: 本期已售商品相应的存货成本。

terms.title: FIFO
terms.detail: 存货成本分配中假设较早购入或生产的单位先被售出。

terms.title: depreciation
terms.detail: 在使用寿命内系统分摊有形非流动资产的可折旧金额。

terms.title: residual value
terms.detail: 资产达到预期寿命终点时，预计处置可收回的净额。

terms.title: straight-line depreciation
terms.detail: 以同等时间单位平均分配资产可折旧金额的方法。

terms.title: amortization
terms.detail: 在适用期限内系统分配无形资产成本或某些其他项目差额。

terms.title: impairment
terms.detail: 当资产账面金额超过按适用准则确定的可收回金额时确认的降低。

terms.title: deferred tax asset
terms.detail: 由可抵扣暂时性差异、税务亏损等产生并满足确认条件的未来税收利益。

terms.title: deferred tax liability
terms.detail: 由应纳税暂时性差异等产生、与未来额外应交所得税相关的负债。

terms.title: temporary difference
terms.detail: 资产或负债账面金额与计税基础之间、未来通常会转回的差异。

terms.title: contract liability
terms.detail: 企业已收或应收客户款项、仍须向客户转让商品或服务的义务。

terms.title: revenue recognition
terms.detail: 确定何时以及按多少金额在财务报表确认取得的收入。

terms.title: right-of-use asset
terms.detail: 租赁期内使用标的资产的合同权利对应的资产。

terms.title: lease liability
terms.detail: 承租人按约定支付租赁付款的现时义务。

terms.title: diluted EPS
terms.detail: 在考虑具有稀释作用的潜在普通股及相应利润调整后计算的每股收益。

terms.title: quick ratio
terms.detail: 通常用现金、可流通短期证券和应收款合计除以流动负债。

terms.title: current ratio
terms.detail: 流动资产除以流动负债，用于观察短期偿债缓冲。

terms.title: common-size statement
terms.detail: 把多个报表项目除以同一基数，以便比较结构和变化。

terms.title: interest coverage
terms.detail: 通常用 EBIT 除以利息费用，衡量经营收益对付息的覆盖。

terms.title: DuPont analysis
terms.detail: 把净资产收益率拆成利润率、资产周转和财务杠杆等驱动项。

terms.title: asset turnover
terms.detail: 收入相对于一定期间平均总资产的比率。

terms.title: equity multiplier
terms.detail: 资产与权益之比，杜邦分解中通常使用可比期间均值。

terms.title: earnings quality
terms.detail: 报告利润真实反映业务表现、可持续性和现金生成能力的程度。

terms.title: net present value
terms.detail: 按适当折现率计算的项目未来现金流现值减去初始净投入。

terms.title: internal rate of return
terms.detail: 使一组现金流净现值为零的折现率。

terms.title: cost of capital
terms.detail: 为获得各类融资并补偿其提供者承担风险所需的收益率。

terms.title: weighted average cost of capital
terms.detail: 按目标融资权重合成股权、税后债务等各项资本成本。

terms.title: capital rationing
terms.detail: 当资本预算有限时，在若干可投资项目间分配资金。

terms.title: mutually exclusive projects
terms.detail: 接受一个项目后就无法再接受另一项目的备选投资。

terms.title: incremental cash flow
terms.detail: 因接受某项决策而相对于可比基准发生的现金流差额。

terms.title: payback period
terms.detail: 项目累计现金流达到初始投资额所需时间。

terms.title: discounted payback
terms.detail: 折现后的未来现金流累计覆盖初始投资额所需时间。

terms.title: sensitivity analysis
terms.detail: 检验单一或若干输入变化如何影响模型结果。

terms.title: scenario analysis
terms.detail: 用经济含义一致的一组输入假设评估不同情景的结果。

terms.title: operating leverage
terms.detail: 固定营运成本使利润相对于销售量变化的敏感性扩大。

terms.title: financial leverage
terms.detail: 债务等固定融资义务对股权收益与风险的放大作用。

terms.title: contribution margin
terms.detail: 收入减去可变成本后的金额，可用来承担固定成本和利润。

terms.title: capital structure
terms.detail: 企业使用债务、股权等资金来源的构成。

terms.title: working capital
terms.detail: 常指流动资产减流动负债，分析时可按经营口径调整。

terms.title: cash conversion cycle
terms.detail: 存货天数加应收天数减应付天数，表示经营资金净占用时间。

terms.title: days inventory outstanding
terms.detail: 从购入或生产到销售平均占用存货的天数。

terms.title: days sales outstanding
terms.detail: 从确认销售到收款的平均天数。

terms.title: days payable outstanding
terms.detail: 从得到供应商采购货物或服务到付款的平均天数。

terms.title: trade credit
terms.detail: 供应商允许买方在交付后按约定期限付款的短期融资。

terms.title: agency conflict
terms.detail: 代理人目标与委托人利益不一致，可能偏离委托目标。

terms.title: corporate governance
terms.detail: 董事会、管理层及其他利益相关方之间的权责、监督和问责安排。

terms.title: independent director
terms.detail: 与管理层和其他相关方没有可能显著影响独立判断关系的董事。

terms.title: stakeholder
terms.detail: 能影响企业经营或受企业决策影响的个人或机构。

terms.title: share repurchase
terms.detail: 公司买回自己发行在外的股份。

terms.title: treasury shares
terms.detail: 公司回购并持有、尚未注销且通常不具备外部股东权利的股份。

terms.title: economic profit
terms.detail: 在税后经营利润中扣减全部投入资本的机会成本。

terms.title: invested capital
terms.detail: 企业为经营活动投入的资金，可用经营资产和经营负债等口径度量。

terms.title: NOPAT
terms.detail: 企业营业利润在扣除对应经营税负后所剩的利润。

terms.title: common stock
terms.detail: 对企业剩余资产和利润享有权利的股权证券，通常附有表决权。

terms.title: preferred stock
terms.detail: 就股息或清算通常优先于普通股、一般仍劣后于债权的股权证券。

terms.title: cost of equity
terms.detail: 普通股投资者为承担预期风险要求的收益率。

terms.title: capital asset pricing model
terms.detail: 以无风险利率加资产贝塔乘市场风险溢价估算要求收益率。

terms.title: equity risk premium
terms.detail: 投资股票市场相对于无风险资产所要求的额外预期收益。

terms.title: beta
terms.detail: 回归意义下资产回报对市场或其他指定因子回报变动的敏感度。

terms.title: multifactor model
terms.detail: 用多个共同因子及各自的暴露解释收益、风险或必要回报。

terms.title: factor premium
terms.detail: 投资者因承担指定定价因子风险而获得或要求的额外回报。

terms.title: dividend discount model
terms.detail: 用未来预期股利的折现和估计股权价值。

terms.title: Gordon growth model
terms.detail: 假设股利无限期按固定增长率增长且折现率更高的股利估值模型。

terms.title: payout ratio
terms.detail: 分配给股东的股利占当期利润的比例。

terms.title: retention ratio
terms.detail: 当期利润中未作为股利分派而留在企业的比例。

terms.title: sustainable growth rate
terms.detail: 在稳定盈利能力与资本结构等假设下，常估为留存率乘 ROE。

terms.title: forward P/E
terms.detail: 股价除以预测期每股收益。

terms.title: trailing P/E
terms.detail: 股价除以最近历史期间的每股收益，常用过去 12 个月。

terms.title: enterprise value
terms.detail: 经营业务对各资本提供者的市场价值，常由市值加债务等再扣除超额现金估算。

terms.title: EV/EBITDA
terms.detail: 用企业价值除以未扣利息、税、折旧和摊销的利润。

terms.title: free cash flow to equity
terms.detail: 经营和投资后、计入净举债等影响可供普通股股东取得的现金流。

terms.title: terminal value
terms.detail: 明确预测期末对后续全部现金流评估的价值。

terms.title: market capitalization
terms.detail: 流通在外普通股数量乘市场价格。

terms.title: limit order
terms.detail: 设置最高买价或最低卖价的委托，成交受流动性与价格约束。

terms.title: market order
terms.detail: 以可得到的市场价格尽快成交的指令，成交价格可能变动。

terms.title: bid-ask spread
terms.detail: 可成交的最优卖价与最优买价之间的差额。

terms.title: market-cap weighting
terms.detail: 按成分证券市值或可投资流通市值占比确定指数权重。

terms.title: semi-strong-form efficiency
terms.detail: 证券价格已经吸收全部公开信息的市场有效性假设。

terms.title: equity valuation
terms.detail: 以现金流、市场比较或资产价值等方法估算权益价值。

terms.title: investment thesis
terms.detail: 用可验证的经营或估值假设解释某项证券投资的理由。

terms.title: competitive advantage
terms.detail: 帮助企业保护或提高相对盈利能力的资源、规模、品牌或成本结构等因素。

terms.title: switching costs
terms.detail: 客户更换供应商或平台所需的时间、费用和迁移风险。

terms.title: return on invested capital
terms.detail: 税后净营业利润相对于经营投入资本的比率。

terms.title: face value
terms.detail: 债务合同上用于确定本金偿还或计算票息的名义金额。

terms.title: coupon rate
terms.detail: 合同约定的年票息与名义本金之比。

terms.title: coupon payment
terms.detail: 债券根据合同按期支付给持有者的利息。

terms.title: yield to maturity
terms.detail: 以当前价格作为现值、用合同现金流求得的统一折现率。

terms.title: current yield
terms.detail: 年度票息额除以债券当前市场价格。

terms.title: discount bond
terms.detail: 当前价格低于面值的债券。

terms.title: premium bond
terms.detail: 当前价格高于面值的债券。

terms.title: zero-coupon bond
terms.detail: 不定期付息、通常以折价发行并到期支付面值的债券。

terms.title: spot rate
terms.detail: 从估值日到特定到期时点的零息折现利率。

terms.title: forward rate
terms.detail: 约定的未来期间起点与终点之间的利率，可由即期利率曲线隐含推出。

terms.title: yield curve
terms.detail: 显示信用或其他属性可比的工具在不同期限上的收益率。

terms.title: term spread
terms.detail: 两个不同期限收益率之间的差，通常以长期减短期计算。

terms.title: credit spread
terms.detail: 信用风险较高债券与可比基准的收益率差，也可能反映流动性等其他因素。

terms.title: Macaulay duration
terms.detail: 按每笔现金流现值占总现值的比重加权计算的平均收款期限。

terms.title: modified duration
terms.detail: 债券价格对收益率小幅变化的一阶相对敏感度。

terms.title: effective duration
terms.detail: 通过基准利率冲击后的估值变化近似价格敏感度，可适用于期权影响现金流的工具。

terms.title: key rate duration
terms.detail: 债券价值对曲线上某一关键期限利率变化的局部敏感度。

terms.title: convexity
terms.detail: 反映债券价格对收益率变化的二阶敏感度，用于改进较大变动的估算。

terms.title: basis point
terms.detail: 利率与利差单位，1 个基点等于 0.01 个百分点。

terms.title: reinvestment risk
terms.detail: 未来收入以低于原假设的利率重新投资的风险。

terms.title: callable bond
terms.detail: 发行人在合同条件下可以提前偿还的债券。

terms.title: putable bond
terms.detail: 持有人在合同条件下可要求发行人提前偿还的债券。

terms.title: default probability
terms.detail: 在指定期间发生定义中违约事件的概率。

terms.title: loss given default
terms.detail: 债务违约后未能收回的损失相对于违约风险暴露的比例。

terms.title: exposure at default
terms.detail: 发生违约时预计尚未结清的敞口金额。

terms.title: expected loss
terms.detail: 简化单期模型下可用违约概率、违约损失率与风险暴露的乘积估计。

terms.title: senior debt
terms.detail: 在约定受偿顺位中优先于次级债务的债权。

terms.title: subordinated debt
terms.detail: 在约定受偿顺位中劣后于高级债务的债权。

terms.title: covenant
terms.detail: 债券或贷款合同中约束发行人行为、指标或信息披露的约定。

terms.title: floating-rate note
terms.detail: 票息定期按照参考利率与约定利差重设的债券。

terms.title: derivative
terms.detail: 价值取决于标的资产、利率、指数或事件等变量的合约。

terms.title: underlying
terms.detail: 决定衍生品价值或支付的资产、利率、指数或变量。

terms.title: notional amount
terms.detail: 用来计算衍生品支付的参考金额，通常不等于初始投入。

terms.title: forward contract
terms.detail: 双方约定未来按事先确定条件交易标的的双边合约。

terms.title: futures contract
terms.detail: 通过交易所及清算机制交易、按标准规格与保证金规则执行的合约。

terms.title: delivery price
terms.detail: 远期合约约定到期买卖标的所使用的价格。

terms.title: forward price
terms.detail: 当前市场上新签订远期合约时使初始价值为零的交割价格。

terms.title: forward value
terms.detail: 合约签订后根据当前远期价格、原交割价和折现等因素重估的价值。

terms.title: long position
terms.detail: 在标的价格上升时通常获益的头寸，具体取决于合约结构。

terms.title: short position
terms.detail: 在标的价格下降时通常获益的头寸，具体取决于合约结构。

terms.title: mark-to-market
terms.detail: 按当前市场价格重新计量头寸，期货通过保证金安排结算变动。

terms.title: margin account
terms.detail: 持有清算抵押资金并反映结算损益的交易账户。

terms.title: variation margin
terms.detail: 按市场价值变化在交易各方之间收付的保证金款项。

terms.title: call option
terms.detail: 买方拥有按执行价买入标的或取得相应现金结算的权利。

terms.title: put option
terms.detail: 买方拥有按执行价卖出标的或取得相应现金结算的权利。

terms.title: strike price
terms.detail: 期权行权时用于买卖标的或确定结算金额的合约价格。

terms.title: option premium
terms.detail: 期权买方向卖方支付以获取权利的初始价格。

terms.title: European option
terms.detail: 只能在到期日行权的期权。

terms.title: American option
terms.detail: 通常可以在到期日或此前允许日期行权的期权。

terms.title: intrinsic value
terms.detail: 期权按当前标的价格立即行权所对应的非负价值。

terms.title: put-call parity
terms.detail: 在适用条件下，匹配的欧式看涨、看跌、标的和执行价折现值之间的无套利关系。

terms.title: interest rate swap
terms.detail: 双方按约定本金交换不同计息方式产生的利息现金流。

terms.title: fixed leg
terms.detail: 互换合约中按约定固定利率计算支付的一侧。

terms.title: floating leg
terms.detail: 互换合约中与参考利率重设挂钩的一侧。

terms.title: basis risk
terms.detail: 套期工具与被套期对象价格变动不完全匹配所产生的风险。

terms.title: cross hedge
terms.detail: 用与被套期风险相关但并非同一标的的合约对冲。

terms.title: arbitrage
terms.detail: 利用等价经济头寸定价差异获得无风险收益的理论策略。

terms.title: counterparty risk
terms.detail: 合同对方无法按约履行义务造成损失的风险。

terms.title: protective put
terms.detail: 持有标的同时买入看跌期权，以保留上行并设置下行保护。

terms.title: payoff
terms.detail: 给定到期标的价格，合约在到期结算的金额，通常尚未扣除初始成本。

terms.title: alternative investment
terms.detail: 相对于传统公开股票、债券和现金的投资类型，如私募、房地产和商品。

terms.title: private equity
terms.detail: 对不在公开市场交易或拟私有化企业进行的权益资本投资。

terms.title: venture capital
terms.detail: 对早期或偏早期高成长企业提供的权益资本。

terms.title: leveraged buyout
terms.detail: 用较高比例债务融资取得公司控制权的收购。

terms.title: limited partner
terms.detail: 通常投入资金并承担有限责任、较少参与基金日常管理的投资者。

terms.title: general partner
terms.detail: 管理合伙基金、作出投资决策并承担约定责任的一方。

terms.title: capital commitment
terms.detail: 投资者按协议承诺在基金需要时可被要求缴付的金额。

terms.title: capital call
terms.detail: 基金管理人按约定要求投资者实际缴付部分承诺资本。

terms.title: distribution waterfall
terms.detail: 按照返还本金、优先收益、业绩分成等顺序分配基金回款的规则。

terms.title: carried interest
terms.detail: 普通合伙人或管理人按协议从基金收益取得的分配份额。

terms.title: preferred return
terms.detail: 通常在管理人分成前优先分给投资者的约定回报。

terms.title: management fee
terms.detail: 管理人按协议以资产或认缴资本等为计费基数收取的费用。

terms.title: incentive fee
terms.detail: 按投资业绩及约定门槛等条件计取的费用。

terms.title: high-water mark
terms.detail: 用于防止对恢复至既往计费峰值的增值重复计费的净值门槛。

terms.title: J-curve effect
terms.detail: 私募基金前期费用或投资先于退出回款，净业绩可能先降后升。

terms.title: lockup period
terms.detail: 投资者通常不能按常规条件赎回所投份额的一段时间。

terms.title: redemption gate
terms.detail: 按合同临时或持续限制一定期间可赎回比例或金额的安排。

terms.title: hedge fund
terms.detail: 采用较灵活策略、可能使用卖空和杠杆的一类集合投资工具。

terms.title: market-neutral strategy
terms.detail: 对冲投资组合的大部分市场方向暴露，以获取较独立的收益。

terms.title: capitalization rate
terms.detail: 在直接资本化估值中，稳定净营业收入与物业价值之比。

terms.title: net operating income
terms.detail: 物业收入减去日常运营费用，一般不扣融资利息与所得税。

terms.title: equity REIT
terms.translation: 权益型房地产投资信托
terms.detail: 主要投资并经营收益性房地产资产的信托或公司结构。

terms.title: appraisal smoothing
terms.detail: 非频繁估值或沿用前期信息使报告回报波动小于即时市场波动。

terms.title: contango
terms.detail: 常指较远月期货价格高于近月价格的期限结构。

terms.title: backwardation
terms.detail: 常指较远月期货价格低于近月价格的期限结构。

terms.title: roll return
terms.detail: 持续持有合约并更换到期月份时，期货期限结构带来的收益成分。

terms.title: commodity
terms.detail: 可按统一规格交易的原材料或初级产品，如原油、铜和小麦。

terms.title: infrastructure investment
terms.detail: 投资于为经济活动提供长期公共或商业服务的实体资产。

terms.title: regulatory risk
terms.detail: 法规、收益上限或许可要求变化影响现金流与价值的风险。

terms.title: survivorship bias
terms.detail: 排除失败或终止样本导致分析不再代表原始总体。

terms.title: investment policy statement
terms.detail: 记录投资目标、约束、政策配置、职责和评估规则的书面文件。

terms.title: liquidity requirement
terms.detail: 组合需在指定时间以合理成本提供现金的程度。

terms.title: time horizon
terms.detail: 投资政策需覆盖的时间跨度，可按支出和生命周期划分。

terms.title: risk tolerance
terms.detail: 投资者可接受的风险，由承担能力和承担意愿共同决定。

terms.title: ability to take risk
terms.detail: 期限、资产负债和支出等客观条件允许承担的风险量。

terms.title: willingness to take risk
terms.detail: 投资者在心理上愿意接受风险和损失的程度。

terms.title: strategic asset allocation
terms.detail: 基于长期投资目标为各资产类别指定政策权重。

terms.title: tactical asset allocation
terms.detail: 因短期市场判断有意暂时偏离政策资产权重。

terms.title: rebalancing
terms.detail: 交易或使用新增现金把偏离的组合权重拉回目标范围。

terms.title: expected portfolio return
terms.detail: 各资产期望收益率按组合权重加总。

terms.title: mean–variance efficiency
terms.detail: 可行组合中不存在同风险收益更高或同收益风险更低的替代组合。

terms.title: efficient frontier
terms.detail: 均值方差有效组合构成的风险与预期收益集合。

terms.title: global minimum-variance portfolio
terms.detail: 在设定资产集合和约束下使总方差最小的可行组合。

terms.title: systematic risk
terms.detail: 由于共同市场驱动因素而无法通过一般分散化消除的风险。

terms.title: idiosyncratic risk
terms.detail: 来自单一企业或资产的特定风险，可通过分散配置降低。

terms.title: diversification
terms.detail: 组合不完全同向波动的资产，以降低集中风险或组合波动。

terms.title: Sharpe ratio
terms.detail: 用投资超额收益除以收益波动率衡量单位总风险回报。

terms.title: tracking error
terms.detail: 组合收益与基准收益之差的标准差。

terms.title: active return
terms.detail: 组合收益减去基准收益。

terms.title: information ratio
terms.detail: 以平均主动收益除以跟踪误差，衡量单位主动风险获得的收益。

terms.title: benchmark
terms.detail: 用于比较投资表现或约束偏离的参考组合或指数。

terms.title: value at risk
terms.detail: 给定期限和置信水平的损失分位数估计。

terms.title: expected shortfall
terms.detail: 在给定置信水平对应的最坏尾部中，估计损失的平均值。

terms.title: stress testing
terms.detail: 施加极端但有明确含义的冲击，评估组合或融资安排承压的后果。

terms.title: maximum drawdown
terms.detail: 指定期间从历史峰值到其随后最低点的最大百分比跌幅。

terms.title: risk budgeting
terms.detail: 给不同来源分配可接受的风险，并按其对总风险的贡献监测。

terms.title: performance attribution
terms.detail: 把相对于基准的表现拆解为配置、选择等驱动部分。

terms.title: mental accounting
terms.detail: 将可替代资金按来源或用途心理分组，并为各组使用不同决策规则。

terms.title: loss aversion
terms.detail: 相同金额的损失通常对主观感受的影响强于同等收益。

terms.title: anchoring bias
terms.detail: 过度受初始参考值影响，获得新信息后调整不足。
